name: Lynx Iritemo
source:
She has abundant long hair with a hime cut. Slender but with a full bust, she's the person who best understands the first princess.

Versatile, she's able to skillfully utilize various weapons and tools. But regrettably, her actual battle experience is insufficient, and she still has a long way to go as a knight. She prefers blunt weapons, her strong point being the mace.
